surfaces.role: Agent role registry and provider capability registry. Providers are recommendation-only and have no approval/apply/commit/push authority.
surfaces.future_use: Primary source for worker/provider capability matching and authority constraints.

surfaces.role: Lane records, dirty overlap, and ownership lock proposal models with advisory-only authority flags.
surfaces.future_use: Use lane constraints and dirty overlap status as selector input; do not enforce or dispatch from Phase 5.

surfaces.role: Worker contract, ownership zone, conflict report, and handoff packet models with no-execution guarantees.
surfaces.future_use: Use existing worker handoff packet vocabulary for preview-only handoff schema.

surfaces.role: Tools manifest, available routes, model routes, provider capabilities, and approval boundaries.
surfaces.future_use: Use model_routes and provider_capabilities as selector context when route calls are authorized later.

surfaces.role: Available model aliases and paid/API model routing support.
surfaces.future_use: Use only for route metadata in later authorized phases; Phase 5 makes no provider calls.

surfaces.role: Local Ollama route status and model selection helpers.
surfaces.future_use: Use only for local route capability metadata later; Phase 5 does not probe/start/call local models.

surfaces.role: Advisory packet validation for mac worker/subagent sources with explicit no apply/start-worker authority.
surfaces.future_use: Use advisory-only packet constraints for handoff preview validation.

surfaces.role: /coding display surface references worker lanes, provider truth, and approval authority flags.
surfaces.future_use: Keep future preview display compatible with existing status states without UI rebuild.

surfaces.role: Phase 4 permission decisions and risk classes.
surfaces.future_use: Primary input contract for worker selector gating.
